description: This Java interface defines methods for retrieving dropdown options for interest incentive data in the Fineract platform, including entity types, attribute names, condition types, and incentive types.

classes.name: InterestIncentiveDropdownReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to retrieve various dropdown options related to interest incentives.

methods.name: retrieveEntityTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of EnumOptionData representing entity type options.

methods.name: retrieveAttributeNameOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of EnumOptionData representing attribute name options.

methods.name: retrieveConditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of EnumOptionData representing condition type options.

methods.name: retrieveIncentiveTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns a collection of EnumOptionData representing incentive type options.
